title: Wire UI Swing durable renderer rules

records.rule: Wire UI Swing is a renderer for compiled WIRE-UI/0.1 facts, not a parallel authoring system. Journey, business, release, experiment, authentication and permission authority remain outside Swing.

Create and mutate Swing widgets on the EDT. Listeners capture local values/evidence, enqueue UI_ACTION and return; never synchronously call ooRexx, Queue Fabric, JMS/network or application logic from the EDT.
Capture viewRef and renderedRevision when the Swing event is queued. A later incoming patch must not rewrite the historical revision against which the user acted.

Preflight revision, operation shape, instance/parent/order and exact-definition requirements against the semantic mirror before any EDT commit; reject the whole patch rather than leaving a half-mutated UI.

Definition cache identity is immutable; the manifest is the current authorisation set. Inline UI_RENDER_PROFILE manifest is authoritative immediately, later manifests do not redefine/prune cached identity, and deauthorised visible widgets cannot emit actions.

Materials are exact presentation inputs. Interpret only an explicit safe token/recipe vocabulary; never execute Java/reflection/CSS/script/property paths from material data, and restyle existing components in place.

Builder GRID12/FLOW placement is renderer-neutral semantic composition. Swing maps column/span/row/rowSpan/order/region to deterministic layout constraints and never writes absolute pixel coordinates back into Builder truth.

Local selection is not semantic activation. Arrow keys/focus/programmatic selection emit no application action; explicit click/Enter may activate, and outbound detail remains narrowed to index plus recognised server identity.

Collection/window patches mutate authoritative semantic order/membership. LIST_MOVE must reuse unaffected JComponents; LIST_REMOVE/DESTROY_INSTANCE must follow protocol structure; malformed order/membership changes fail transactionally.

For workspace-bound actions, workspaceContext is opaque server-owned evidence. Deep-freeze it at event time and return it unchanged; never manufacture selectedIds or revisions from local Swing selection/table state.

Server v0.17 extends workspaceContext with resultRevision/resultQueryRevision/resultScopeRevision/resultOrderRevision/resultCurrent. Swing preserves unknown/current fields opaquely and lets the server reject stale or forged command context.

Keep ooRexx/BSF integration narrow: recursively convert Table/Directory/Array to Java Map/List, call WireSwingRuntime, drain plain outbound/action objects, and keep JComponents/JFrame private to Java.

WireSwingDesktopWindow owns only JFrame lifecycle and a stable renderer host. DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE must not terminate the JVM or change journey state; any demo authority remains separate from WireSwingRuntime.

The 2026-08-28 19:19 roll-up bundles Swing dev3, Server v0.17 and Builder v0.11. Separate sealed Swing dev5 is newer and remains the recovery baseline; any successor must be requalified against Server v0.17/Builder v0.11 before superseding dev5.

provenance.claim: Qualified renderer rules through sealed dev5.
